import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FiniteField {
        long x;
        FiniteField(long x) {
            this.x = x;
            if (x > 1000000007 || x < 0) {
                System.err.println("Invalid FiniteField!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
        }
        FiniteField() {
            this.x = 0;
        }
        long Value() {
            return x;
        }
        FiniteField add(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(x);
            r.add(o);
            return r;
        }
        FiniteField subtract(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(x);
            r.subtract(o);
            return r;
        }
        FiniteField multiply(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(x);
            r.multiply(o);
            return r;
        }
        FiniteField divide(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField r = new FiniteField(x);
            r.divide(o);
            return r;
        }
        void add(FiniteField o) {
            x = (x + o.x) % 1000000007;
        }
        void subtract(FiniteField o) {
            x = (x + 1000000007 - o.x) % 1000000007;
        }
        void multiply(FiniteField o) {
            x = (x * o.x) % 1000000007;
        }
        void divide(FiniteField o) {
            long p = 1000000007 - 2;
            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 > 0) {
                    multiply(o);
                }
                multiply(o);
                p /= 2;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().split(" ")[0]);
        int d = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().split(" ")[1]);

        FiniteField[][][] shifts = new FiniteField[d][d + 1][d + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts[k][i][(i + k) % d] = new FiniteField(1);
            }
            shifts[k][d][d] = new FiniteField(1);
        }

        FiniteField[][][] units = new FiniteField[d][d + 1][d + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units[k][i][i] = new FiniteField(1);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units[k][k][i] = new FiniteField(1);
            }
        }

        FiniteField[][] identity = new FiniteField[d + 1][d + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            identity[i][i] = new FiniteField(1);
        }

        Map<Long, FiniteField[][]> cache = new HashMap<>();

        Function<Long, FiniteField[][]> find_matrix = p -> {
            if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                return cache.get(p);
            }

            if (p <= d) {
                FiniteField[][] matrix = new FiniteField[d + 1][d + 1];
                for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = new FiniteField(0);
                    }
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                    matrix = multiply(units[k], matrix);
                }
                return matrix;
            }

            long child_p = d;
            while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) child_p *= d;
            FiniteField[][] child = find_matrix.apply(child_p);
            FiniteField[][] matrix = multiply(child, identity);
            long remaining_p = p;
            remaining_p -= child_p;
            for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                if (remaining_p >= child_p) {
                    matrix = multiply(shifts[d - k], multiply(child, multiply(shifts[k], matrix)));
                    remaining_p -= child_p;
                } else if (remaining_p > 0) {
                    matrix = multiply(shifts[d - k], multiply(find_matrix.apply(remaining_p), multiply(shifts[k], matrix)));
                    remaining_p = 0;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }

            cache.put(p, matrix);

            return matrix;
        };

        FiniteField[][] matrix = find_matrix.apply(n);

        FiniteField[] base_vector = new FiniteField[d + 1];
        base_vector[d] = new FiniteField(1);
        FiniteField[] final_vector = multiply(matrix, base_vector);
        FiniteField ans = new FiniteField(0);
        for (FiniteField x : final_vector) {
            ans = ans.add(x);
        }
        pw.println(ans.Value());
        pw.close();
    }

    public static FiniteField[][] multiply(FiniteField[][] a, FiniteField[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;
        if (b.length != m) {
            System.err.println("Matrix dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        int l = b[0].length;
        FiniteField[][] result = new FiniteField[n][l];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    result[i][j] = result[i][j].add(multiply(a[i][k], b[k][j]));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static FiniteField[] multiply(FiniteField[][] matrix, FiniteField[] v) {
        int n = matrix.length;
        int m = matrix[0].length;
        if (v.length != m) {
            System.err.println("Matrix and vector dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        FiniteField[] result = new FiniteField[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                result[i] = result[i].add(multiply(matrix[i][j], v[j]));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}
